stackReview.title: Review {{name}}
stackReview.body: Check what will change on {{env}}, then deploy.
stackReview.bodyUpdate: These services get a newly looked-up digest. Everything else keeps its running image.
stackReview.bodyGit: Bayplan fetched {{ref}} just now and rendered {{folder}} at commit {{sha}}. This shows what would change on {{env}}.

commits.title: What changed in the repository
commits.caption: Commits that changed {{folder}}
commits.capped: Bayplan counted {{total}} commits and stopped there; there may be more.
commits.unavailable: Bayplan can't list the commits, so only the changes are shown.

moved.title: {{ref}} has moved on
moved.body: This deploy uses {{sha}}, the commit you reviewed. {{ref}} is now at {{newSha}}.

git.rollbackNote: Auto-deploy will pause after this roll back, so the repository head isn't deployed over it. Turn it back on when the repository is fixed.

images.title: Images
images.local: Not from a registry. Pinned to the local image ID.
images.gitNote: Only images whose reference changed in the repository are looked up again. The others keep the digest they run.

deployErrors.draftChanged: That changed while you were looking at it. Reload the page and try again.
deployErrors.pinsInvalid: The images changed since this review. Reload the page and try again.
deployErrors.needsAdmin: This stack needs Admin to deploy. Ask an Admin, or take out what needs it.
deployErrors.nameClash: A stack with this name that Bayplan doesn't manage already exists on this environment.
deployErrors.targetChanged: This environment is no longer the kind of target the stack was made for.
deployErrors.tooMany: You already have 5 deploys running. Wait for one to finish.
deployErrors.permission: You can't deploy on this environment.
deployErrors.lost: The server didn't answer. The deploy may have started: check the stack before you try again.
deployErrors.generic: Couldn't start the deploy. Check the connection and try again.

changes.label: What the review shows
changes.recreatedBecause: Recreated with {{because}}, whose network, processes or volumes it shares. Settings and pinned image stay the same.
changes.restartedBecause: Restarted because {{because}} is recreated (depends_on with restart: true). Same container, settings and image.

detail.removed: Removed from the stack. Deleted with the deploy.

firstDeploy.title: First deploy
firstDeploy.body: Nothing from this stack is running yet, so everything below is new.

noChanges.title: No changes
noChanges.body: The stack is the same as what's running. There's nothing to deploy.
noChanges.bodyUpdate: Every selected image is already up to date.

reasons.lookup: Bayplan can't look up {{ref}} right now.

error.title: Couldn't load the review.
error.body: Check the connection and try again.
error.targetChanged: This environment is no longer the kind of target the stack was made for.
